comment: * A class that represents an object to be shown in the overlay layer.

methods.name: public BitmapDrawable getBitmapDrawable()
methods.comment:
* Returns the bitmap that this object represents.
         *
         * @return BitmapDrawable that this object has.

methods.name: public boolean isAnimationStarted()
methods.comment:
* Returns the started status of the animation.
         *
         * @return True if the animation has started, false otherwise.

methods.name: public OverlayObject setAlphaAnimation(float startAlpha, float endAlpha)
methods.comment:
* Sets animation for varying alpha.
         *
         * @param startAlpha Starting alpha value for the animation, where 1.0 means
         * fully opaque and 0.0 means fully transparent.
         * @param endAlpha Ending alpha value for the animation.
         * @return This OverlayObject to allow for chaining of calls.

methods.name: public OverlayObject setTranslateYAnimation(int deltaY)
methods.comment:
* Sets animation for moving objects vertically.
         *
         * @param deltaY Distance to move in pixels.
         * @return This OverlayObject to allow for chaining of calls.

methods.name: public OverlayObject setDuration(long duration)
methods.comment:
* Sets how long the animation will last.
         *
         * @param duration Duration in milliseconds
         * @return This OverlayObject to allow for chaining of calls.

methods.name: public OverlayObject setInterpolator(Interpolator interpolator)
methods.comment:
* Sets the acceleration curve for this animation.
         *
         * @param interpolator The interpolator which defines the acceleration curve
         * @return This OverlayObject to allow for chaining of calls.

methods.name: public OverlayObject setAnimationEndListener(OnAnimationEndListener listener)
methods.comment:
* Binds an animation end listener to the animation.
         *
         * @param listener the animation end listener to be notified.
         * @return This OverlayObject to allow for chaining of calls.

methods.name: public void startAnimation(long startTime)
methods.comment:
* Starts the animation and sets the start time.
         *
         * @param startTime Start time to be set in Millis

methods.name: public boolean update(long currentTime)
methods.comment:
* Calculates and updates current bounds and alpha value.
         *
         * @param currentTime Current time.in millis
